reason: Verification failed due to critical spec deviations (mandate gating bug, missing Location/visit logic, unused visibility, empty main). With one iteration remaining, we can still address the most impactful blockers to achieve compliance: fix mandate enable/disable, restore a functional main(), add visibility effects (at least via workplaces, ideally minimal Location), map key parameters (affordability, price elasticity, case-prevalence effect), and optimize BFS. These targeted fixes should materially improve correctness and bring the model closer to the specification before hitting the iteration cap.

specific_areas: Fix mandate gating: add mandate_enabled flag to Government and gate issue_or_lift_mandate accordingly; ensure Simulation passes mandate_enabled.
Restore a functional main(): initialize Simulation, run, evaluate key metrics, and save/print results.
Implement visibility in decision utility: at minimum, use WorkplaceSchool.adoption_visibility to blend observed local mask rate into peer influence.

Add minimal Location class and integrate basic visit loop (capacity, mask_requirement, enforcement_strictness, visibility_of_mask_use); if time-constrained, implement scaffold plus visibility blend and enforcement counters.

Align parameters with spec: use case_prevalence_effect_on_risk_perception in risk updates; implement affordability_threshold and price_elasticity_of_demand in purchase logic; introduce homophily_by_attitude rewiring; add Individual.misinformation_exposure affecting campaign/media response.
Optimize BFS in network_cascade_size using deque.
Fix validation scenarios to respect mandate_disabled (push mandate window outside horizon or rely on mandate_enabled=false) and, if locations are added, include a visibility/enforcement validation.

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-anchor on the original spec: ensure Location entities, mandate gating, visibility effects, and specified behaviors (visit_locations, comply_with_policy_if_present, share_information_with_neighbors) are either implemented or minimally approximated.

data_analysis.adjustments: No new data integration this round; focus on correct usage of provided parameters within the simulation.

model_planning.adjustments: Prioritize a minimal yet compliant Location/visit design and parameter mapping that can be implemented in one iteration. Defer advanced heterogeneity unless it directly supports compliance.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement the mandate_enabled flag and logic; create a minimal Location class with key attributes; integrate visibility into decision utility; extend purchase logic with affordability and elasticity; add homophily rewiring; introduce misinformation_exposure; replace no-op main with a runnable entry point.

code_verification.adjustments: Add targeted checks: (1) mandate_enabled=false yields no activation across all days; (2) main() runs end-to-end without exceptions; (3) visibility parameter changes shift adoption appropriately; (4) BFS function returns consistent results and runs faster on larger N.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run short horizon smoke tests with and without mandate; with high/low visibility; and with constrained supply to ensure masks_sold increments and compliance metrics update.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Update validation to include a no-mandate condition and a mandate condition; if Location is added, include a check that compliance_in_mandated_locations > compliance_without_mandate, holding other factors constant.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise, code-referenced change notes and confirm fixes to previously critical issues (mandate gating, main(), visibility, parameter mapping) with before/after behavior summaries.
